author: claude
description: Support wants to refund single items instead of whole orders. This adds `refundPartial()`, which refunds a given number of cents and moves the order to a new `partially_refunded` status until the full amount has been refunded. Tests cover the happy path and input validation.

defects.mechanism: refundPartial looks the order up by id without checking order.userId === userId, so any user can refund any other user's order (refundOrder enforces ownership; the new path skips it).
The cap compares each refund to totalCents instead of the remaining balance (totalCents - refundedCents), so repeated partial refunds can exceed the order total.
The PR adds a partially_refunded status, but refundOrder still only accepts status 'paid', so an order can never be fully refunded after a partial refund.
